q1.explanationZh: our 是形容词性物主代词“我们的”，后面要接名词，如 our country。

q2.explanationZh: ours 是名词性物主代词，相当于 our + 名词，后面不再接名词。

q3.explanationZh: we 的反身代词是 ourselves，复数以 -selves 结尾。

q4.explanationZh: out 副词“出；向外”，go out“出去”。

q5.explanationZh: outcome = out + come，“出来的东西”即“结果”。

q6.explanationZh: outdoor 是形容词，放在名词前，如 an outdoor pool。

q7.explanationZh: outdoors 是副词，带 -s，如 It's cold outdoors.。书末答案印作 ourdoors，是印刷错误，正确拼写是 outdoors。

q8.explanationZh: outer 形容词“外面的”，只放在名词前，如 outer walls。

q9.explanationZh: outgoing 形容词“外向的”，an outgoing person“性格外向的人”。

q10.explanationZh: outline 既是名词“轮廓；提纲”，也是动词“概述”。

q11.explanationZh: outlook = out + look，“向外看”引申为“观点；前景”。

q12.explanationZh: output = out + put，“产出”即“产量；输出”。

q13.explanationZh: outside 可作介词或副词“在……外边”，反义词 inside。

q14.explanationZh: outstanding 来自 stand out“突出”，形容词“杰出的”。

q15.explanationZh: outward 可作形容词和副词“向外（的）”，-ward 表示方向。

q16.explanationZh: oven 名词“烤箱”，注意读音 /ˈʌvən/。

q17.explanationZh: over 介词“在……正上方；超过”，副词“结束”，如 The game is over.。

q19.explanationZh: overcoat = over + coat，“穿在外面的衣服”即“大衣”。

q20.explanationZh: overcome 及物动词“克服”，overcome difficulties“克服困难”，过去式 overcame。

q21.explanationZh: overflow = over + flow，“流过头”即“溢出”。

q22.explanationZh: overhead 可作形容词“头顶上的”和副词“在头顶”。（本题词性按原书印刷，与手册的 adj. / adv. 顺序相反。）

q23.explanationZh: overlook 及物动词“俯瞰；忽视”，overlook the whole city“俯瞰全城”。

q24.explanationZh: overnight = over + night，“整夜；一夜之间”。

q25.explanationZh: overseas = over + seas，“在海外的；在海外”，结尾有 -s。

q26.explanationZh: overtake 及物动词“超过”，过去式 overtook。

q27.explanationZh: owe 及物动词“欠；把……归功于”，owe sth. to sb.。

q28.explanationZh: owing 形容词“欠着的”，owing to“由于”。书末答案印作 owning，是印刷错误，正确拼写是 owing。

q29.explanationZh: own 形容词“自己的”（one's own），动词“拥有”。

q30.explanationZh: own 加 -er 构成名词 owner“所有人”。

q31.explanationZh: ox 名词“牛（公牛）”，复数是不规则的 oxen。

q32.explanationZh: out of“缺乏，没有”，如 be out of money“没钱了”。

q33.explanationZh: average“平均的”+ output“产量”，固定说法 the average output。

q34.explanationZh: over and over“一再地”，也可说 over and over again。

q35.explanationZh: be overcome with/by“因……而无能为力；被……压倒”，用被动形式。

q36.explanationZh: owe sth. to sb.“把某事归功于某人”。

q37.explanationZh: owing to“由于”，后接名词或动名词，相当于 because of。

q38.explanationZh: hang“悬挂”+ over“在……上方”，如 The lamp hung over the table.。

q39.explanationZh: over and over“一再地，再三地”（与第 3 题相同）。

q40.explanationZh: outdoor 是形容词，放在名词 pool 前；以元音开头用 an。

q41.explanationZh: outer“外面的”修饰 wall，the outer wall“外墙”。

q42.explanationZh: of one's own“某人自己的”，如 a room of my own。

q43.explanationZh: the owner of sth.“某物的主人”。

q44.explanationZh: outward 作副词“向外”，go outward“走出去”。

q46.explanationZh: by oneself“独自；靠自己”，主语是“我们”时用 by ourselves。

q47.explanationZh: “天冷，穿上你的大衣”，your 后接名词 overcoat。

q48.explanationZh: “在农场见过牛吗”，an 后接单数名词 ox。

q49.explanationZh: “接住溢出物”，the 后接名词 overflow“溢出物”。

q50.explanationZh: “结果并不像他希望的那样”，主语用名词 outcome。

q51.explanationZh: “房子的外墙”，名词 walls 前用形容词 outer。

q52.explanationZh: “对他的人生观产生深刻影响”，his 后接名词 outlook“观点，看法”。

q53.explanationZh: “外面在下雨”，outside 作副词修饰 raining。

q54.explanationZh: “去海外”，go overseas，overseas 作副词，前面不加介词。

q57.sampleAnswer: It's time for us to take responsibility for our country.
references: It's time for us to take responsibility for our country.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q57.explanationZh: “到了……的时候了”= It's time for sb. to do sth.；“承担责任”= take responsibility for。

q58.sampleAnswer: There are still lots of difficulties that we have to overcome.
references: There are still lots of difficulties that we have to overcome.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q58.explanationZh: “有……”用 There be 句型；that 引导定语从句修饰 difficulties，overcome“克服”。

q59.sampleAnswer: I owe my progress to my teacher's help and encouragement.
references: I owe my progress to my teacher's help and encouragement.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q59.explanationZh: “把……归功于……”= owe sth. to sth./sb.。

q60.sampleAnswer: Who is the owner of that motorcycle?
references: Who is the owner of that motorcycle?

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.sampleAnswer: The castle that has survived several wars overlooks the whole city, witnessing its rise and fall over the past five centuries.
references: The castle that has survived several wars overlooks the whole city, witnessing its rise and fall over the past five centuries.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: “俯瞰”= overlook，主语是单数用 overlooks；“见证”用现在分词 witnessing 作伴随状语。

q62.sampleAnswer: She is a girl overflowing with kindness.
references: She is a girl overflowing with kindness.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: “充满……”= overflow with，现在分词短语 overflowing with kindness 修饰 girl。

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: 主语 we 和宾语是同一些人，宾语用反身代词 ourselves。

q64.sampleAnswer: No matter how much advice you give him, he just sticks to his own opinion.
references: No matter how much advice you give him, he just sticks to his own opinion.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “无论多少”= no matter how much；advice 不可数；“固执己见”= stick to one's own opinion。

q65.sampleAnswer: For example, you might want to speak about your interests and hobbies outside the school.
references: For example, you might want to speak about your interests and hobbies outside the school.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “在校外”= outside (the) school，outside 作介词。

q66.sampleAnswer: Out rushed the girl who had just been criticized, crying and not knowing at all that in fact it made her parents sadder.
references: Out rushed the girl who had just been criticized, crying and not knowing at all that in fact it made her parents sadder.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: 副词 out 放在句首，主语是名词时句子完全倒装：Out rushed the girl ...；crying 和 not knowing 作伴随状语。
